chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from Zakariyya ibn Adam, who said:
I asked al-Rida عليه السلام about the fistula, and he said: Only three things invalidate wudu (ablution): urine, feces, and wind.

key_terms.النَّاصُورِ: a fistula or abnormal bodily discharge condition mentioned in the question
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification for salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَنْقُضُ: invalidates or breaks a state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What things invalidate wudu (ablution) according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام regarding what invalidates wudu (ablution). It states that the nullifiers of wudu (ablution) are restricted to three: urine, feces, and wind, indicating that the condition mentioned in the question does not itself invalidate wudu (ablution).
